note: Assumed traffic demand, turning choices and controller plan. Junction nodes within 30 m of the crossing are joined into one node and every incoming stop line is set back (endOffset) to 6 m outside the scramble polygon, so waiting vehicles never stand in the pedestrian area. Yellow 137-140 s, then all red; all central signals held red in the pedestrian phase. Two-cycle warmup. Browser additionally freezes the traffic clock if pedestrians overrun clearance. Cycle wrap is a replay cut, not continuous vehicle identities.
